## Pre-registration
<!-- Before you look at this run's output. One prediction line per metric you predict, as a range:
`- Prediction: <metric> [lo, hi]` with a metric name from task.json. -->
- Prediction: accuracy [0.747, 0.759]
- Prediction: time [4.62, 4.80]
- Prediction: complete [1, 1]
- Supports if: (H1.9) accuracy >= tip + 0.2 pp (>= 0.7557).
- Refutes if: accuracy <= tip - 0.3 pp (<= 0.7507): full whitening throughout is right. Within +-0.15 pp: close H1.9.
  Tip = E058 (0.7537, 4.696 s). Pre-NS Frobenius scale s_t = 0.5 -> 0.08 linearly over steps; the NS output is
  rescaled per shape group to the tip's measured mean output norm (ratios 0.73-0.93 x sqrt(min)), so magnitudes match
  on average (+-~10% over time). Synthetic check: s=1/0.5/0.08 give top/median singular-value ratio 5/10/30 at equal norm.
  Note the tip runs at s=1, while the idea assumed "Frobenius 1" = s 1; s=0.5 at the start is already less whitened than
  the tip throughout. Point -0.1 pp: E030 showed spectrum reshaping can hurt a lot; this is gentler. Time ~+0.3%.

## Contingencies
<!-- The next step for each outcome, decided now. -->
- If it lands in the predicted range: keep only if accuracy >= tip + 0.12 pp (added complexity); else discard.
- If it moves the right way but less than predicted: (gain > 0.4 pp) try a gentler schedule (1.0 -> 0.3).
- If it moves the opposite way: discard; close H1.9.
- If it crashes: n/a.
